title: ScenarioEnvelope
description: Top-level scenario document wrapping all four output layers of a scenario-forge scenario.

scenario_id.description: Collision-safe, run-specific identifier: scenario:<version>:<256-bit hex digest of run_id|candidate_id|attempt>.

candidate_id.description: Stable canonical candidate identity (cand:v1:<128-bit hex>) that produced this scenario.

attack_complexity_assessment.description: Closed, versioned deterministic attack-complexity assessment (cmps.7): candidate lower bound, final required capability level, rule version, typed reasons, and evidence - persisted separately from the immutable actor_profile.capability_level.

behavior_spec.description: Structured behavior specification with projection-traceable actions and assertions. Pre-alpha: no raw string/dict loophole on the authoritative envelope (422o.4).

projection.description: Deeply immutable, standalone canonical projection snapshot with execution requirements and artifact realization mappings. Every generated scenario must embed exactly one projection block.

rule_version.description: Closed version of the deterministic rule table used.

candidate_lower_bound.description: Lower bound on actor capability computed from typed candidate-v2 projection inputs before Call 0.

final.description: Final required level computed after typed realized actions exist; inherits the candidate lower bound and may only raise it.

AttackComplexityAssessment.description: Closed, versioned attack-complexity assessment record (cmps.7): candidate lower bound and final required capability level with typed reasons, persisted separately from the immutable actor capability.

kind.description: Which typed input surface the reference points at.

ref_id.description: Stable identifier of the referenced input: canonical chain step_id, execution requirement_id, attack-tree node id, or the access-provenance initial_entry_point_id.

reasons.description: Reasons that fired in this phase, ordered deterministically by descending required level then ascending rule_id, deduplicated by rule_id. Empty when the phase assesses as novice.

required_level.description: Capability level this rule requires when it fires.

detail.description: Structured explanation of the trigger, including observed values (e.g. step counts) so the reason stands alone.

evidence.description: Typed references to the exact inputs that fired the rule.

projected_step_ids.description: Canonical projected step IDs that this narrative step realizes. Controlled many-to-many.

canonical_action_kind.description: Canonical action kind from the projected step.

canonical_executor_role.description: Canonical executor role from the projected step.

canonical_boundary_position.description: Canonical boundary position from the projected step.

projected_step_ids.description: Canonical projected step IDs that this tree leaf realizes. Controlled many-to-many.

ProjectionEnvelopeBlock.description:
Deeply immutable, standalone canonical projection persisted on the envelope.

Carries the full immutable projection snapshot, derived execution
requirements, projected taxonomy mappings, canonical ingress identity,
and artifact realization mappings.  Every generated artifact receives
the same fixed projection constraints; generated content realizes but
never chooses or mutates the projection.
ProjectionEnvelopeBlock.title: ProjectionEnvelopeBlock

ProjectionTraceabilityViolation.description: A single typed traceability violation attributed to a generated stage.
ProjectionTraceabilityViolation.title: ProjectionTraceabilityViolation

ProjectionTraceabilityViolationCode.description: Typed violation codes for projection traceability failures.
ProjectionTraceabilityViolationCode.title: ProjectionTraceabilityViolationCode

ProjectionTraceabilityStage.description: Earliest responsible generated stage for a traceability violation.
ProjectionTraceabilityStage.title: ProjectionTraceabilityStage

ArtifactRealizationMapping.description:
Map one generated artifact element to one or more projected steps.

Controlled many-to-many realization (contract §5): one artifact element
may realize multiple projected steps (combine), and one projected step
may be realized by multiple artifact elements (split).  The total order
of projected steps must be preserved across element ordering within the
same artifact stage.

element_id.description: Generated artifact element identifier: narrative step number as a string, attack-tree leaf node id, or behavior step reference.
element_id.title: Element Id

projected_step_ids.description: One or more projected step IDs from the projection's selected_step_ids.  Must be unique within this mapping.
projected_step_ids.title: Projected Step Ids

ArtifactRealizationMapping.title: ArtifactRealizationMapping

ArtifactStage.description: Generated artifact stage that realizes projected steps.
ArtifactStage.title: ArtifactStage

AssertionRealizationMapping.description:
Map a generated behavior assertion to projected observable postconditions.

Assertions map to projected observable postconditions (contract §4), not
mechanically to setup steps.  Each assertion traces to one or more
postconditions owned by one or more selected projected steps.

source_step_ids.description: Projected step IDs that own the postconditions this assertion verifies.  Must be unique within this mapping.
source_step_ids.title: Source Step Ids

projected_postcondition_ids.description: Observable postcondition IDs from the projected steps.  Must be unique within this mapping and resolvable in the source steps.
projected_postcondition_ids.title: Projected Postcondition Ids

AssertionRealizationMapping.title: AssertionRealizationMapping

ObservableOutcomeLink.description:
Explicit link from a step's postcondition to an observable outcome.

Declares that a postcondition is observable through a specific resource
slot as a specific observation kind.  The derivation consumes this link
to produce an :class:`ObservationRequirement`.
ObservableOutcomeLink.title: ObservableOutcomeLink

TaxonomyContext.description:
Pinned taxonomy releases; LAAF is optional and non-authoritative for v1.

An absent ``laaf`` pin means the context is ATLAS-only: any LAAF mapping
decision in the chain then fails closed.  An explicit pin is meaningful
only when the qualifying resolver pins the identical context and carries
authoritative LAAF membership for every exact id.
TaxonomyContext.title: TaxonomyContext

StepResourceLink.description:
Explicit link from a step to a required resource slot.

The ``role`` declares how the slot is used by the step, determining the
execution-requirement derivation.  No inference from action kind, name,
or cardinality is performed by the projection — the link is the sole
authority for requirement derivation.

For ``source_influence`` links the ``slot_id`` is the upstream source
slot (an entry point or integration the attacker influences outside the
trust boundary), ``trust_boundary_slot_id`` is the boundary the source
content crosses, and ``target_ingress_slot_id`` is the canonical ingress
entry point the influenced content flows into.  The target-ingress edge
is explicit: the projection never assumes the chain's initial ingress
implicitly supplies this relation.
StepResourceLink.title: StepResourceLink

ProjectionSnapshot.description: Local structural/pure semantic parse; use qualification for external facts.
ProjectionSnapshot.title: ProjectionSnapshot

AgentInternalResourceReference.description:
Canonical reference to agent-internal state.

Agent-internal state is data assembled or transformed within the
agent's own working context — neither an external entry point, tool,
integration, nor trust boundary.  Capability profiles do not carry
an authoritative agent-internal-state inventory, so this reference
type is **unresolvable** by design: ``contains_resource`` always
returns ``False`` and ``_references_for_kind`` always returns an
empty tuple.  Patterns that require an ``agent_internal`` resource
slot are therefore typed-infeasible for candidate-v2 projection.
AgentInternalResourceReference.title: AgentInternalResourceReference

AuthoritativeFactReference.description: Reference to a pre-existing authoritative fact (never a generated artifact).
AuthoritativeFactReference.title: AuthoritativeFactReference

OutputSurfaceResourceReference.description:
Canonical reference to an output-direction entry point.

An output surface is the agent's rendered-response surface — the
model's output that a client renders or fetches.  It is distinct from
an input entry point (``EntryPointResourceReference``) even though
both resolve to an :class:`EntryPoint` in the capability profile:
only entry points with ``direction == "output"`` qualify as output
surfaces.
OutputSurfaceResourceReference.title: OutputSurfaceResourceReference

BehaviorAction.description:
A structured behavior spec action tied to a projected step.

Each behavior action carries the canonical projected step ID it
realizes and the tree leaf it was derived from, enabling deterministic
traceability without Gherkin parsing.

action_id.description: Stable behavior action identifier, deterministically derived from the tree leaf ID (e.g. 'ba-<leaf_id>').
action_id.title: Action Id

source_leaf_id.description: Attack tree leaf node ID this behavior action was derived from.
source_leaf_id.title: Source Leaf Id

gherkin_keyword.description: Gherkin keyword for this action step.
gherkin_keyword.title: Gherkin Keyword

text.description: Gherkin step text for this action.
text.title: Text

projected_step_ids.description: Canonical projected step IDs this behavior action realizes.

BehaviorAction.title: BehaviorAction

BehaviorAssertion.description:
A structured behavior assertion tied to projected postconditions.

Assertions map to projected observable postconditions, not to setup
steps.  Each assertion carries the canonical postcondition IDs and
source step IDs it verifies.

assertion_id.description: Stable assertion identifier, deterministically derived from the source step and postcondition (e.g. 'assert-<step>-<pc>').
assertion_id.title: Assertion Id

source_step_ids.description: Projected step IDs that own the postconditions this assertion verifies.
source_step_ids.title: Source Step Ids

projected_postcondition_ids.description: Observable postcondition IDs this assertion verifies.
projected_postcondition_ids.title: Projected Postcondition Ids

text.description: Gherkin step text for this assertion.
text.title: Text

BehaviorAssertion.title: BehaviorAssertion

BehaviorSpec.description:
Structured behavior specification with projection traceability.

Carries structured actions and assertions with canonical projected
step/postcondition references, plus the rendered Gherkin text.
Validation can cross-check the structured elements against the
rendered Gherkin and the projection block without parsing Gherkin.

actions.description: Structured behavior actions tied to projected steps.
actions.title: Actions

assertions.description: Structured behavior assertions tied to projected postconditions.
assertions.title: Assertions

BehaviorSpec.title: BehaviorSpec
